title: Sha'ar HaGilgulim (The Gate of Reincarnations)
author: Chaim Vital (Sefaria Community trans)
description: Sha'ar HaGilgulim (The Gate of Reincarnations) by Rabbi Chaim Vital, recording the teachings of his master Isaac Luria, here in the community English translation from Sefaria. Part of the Shemonah She'arim (Eight Gates), it is the classic Kabbalistic treatise on reincarnation (gilgul) and the structure of the soul. It explains the five levels of the soul (nefesh, ruach, neshamah, chayah and yechidah), the roots of souls in the primordial Adam, the sparks scattered through the Fall and their rectification across lifetimes, soul impregnation (ibbur) and spirit possession, how the soul-roots of biblical figures such as Cain, Abel, Moses and the patriarchs reappear in later sages, and the reasons for suffering and particular commandments in terms of tikkun. It also contains Vital's account of Luria's own soul and his circle. It is the fundamental source for Jewish teaching on reincarnation.
